values.quote: '''Volibear''' {{tt|impacts|centered on Volibear's location when the dash ends in any way}} after 1 second
values.binNote: No bin row states this timing explicitly; it is presumably implied by the dash's travel time (over 1 second regardless of distance), but no data value or calculation names a 1-second impact delay.

values.quote: '''Volibear''' also disables enemy {{tip|turrets}} in an area for a duration, rendering them unable to attack, as well as dealing them the {{ccs|same damage|physical}}

mechanics.claim: The impact deals damage to enemies hit only in the epicenter (300 radius), separate from the wider slow radius (500) and turret radius (700).
mechanics.quote: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Damage radius}}|{{tt|500|Slow radius}}|{{tt|700|Turret damage and disable radius}}}}

mechanics.claim: Volibear leaps to the target location with displacement immunity, and the impact/damage happens after the 1 second dash, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Volibear''' gains ''Stormbringer'' for 12 seconds and {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|displacement immunity}} over 1 second

mechanics.claim: Enemies near the impact are slowed by 50% decaying over 1 second, in addition to the damage dealt at the epicenter.
mechanics.quote: '''Volibear''' {{tt|impacts|centered on Volibear's location when the dash ends in any way}} after 1 second, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by 50% decaying over 1 second

mechanics.claim: The bonus health, attack range, Frenzied Maul range, and size increase are granted immediately on cast, not on landing.
mechanics.quote: The additional bonuses are granted on-cast.

mechanics.claim: While transformed, Volibear gains ghosting, bonus health, bonus attack range, increased Frenzied Maul range and increased size, all lasting the 12s Stormbringer duration.
mechanics.quote: '''Volibear''' gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{as|{{sti|50 '''bonus''' attack range}}}}, 25 increased range on ''{{ai|Frenzied Maul|Volibear}}'', and 35% increased {{tip|size}}.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not on landing or on Stormbringer ending.
The ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
